protocol.name: paired-fixed-plan-dispatch-and-2x2-component-replay
protocol.retries: Only a receiver transient failure explicitly before commit warrants retry. Recheck permission on each attempt.
protocol.retry_check: Separate 15-P trace. First receiver attempt for each shared/admin item fails before commit.
protocol.positive_control: Every S10 protected ENQUEUE in a fresh gateway under V1, one tick before revocation.
protocol.scope: Single-runner logical times, real AES-GCM and local in-memory JSON receiver. No latency claims.
protocol.success: shared and admin exact receipt values and intended destinations, using the frozen scorer
protocol.privacy: exact protected synthetic value in either stage receiver-visible fields or body, case counted once
protocol.same_tick_rule: Revocation takes effect first at its tick. V1 commit may stay in the ledger if earlier.
protocol.admin_plan_policy: Same previously observed full-arm final decision is replayed in every arm, with no S12 rerun.
